scripts.build: crust build --entry src/index.tsx --bun-plugin @opentui/solid/bun-plugin --minify --target $(bun -p '"bun-"+(process.platform==="win32"?"windows":process.platform)+"-"+process.arch') --outfile dist/gyst && bun scripts/build-skills.ts
scripts.build:release: crust build --entry src/index.tsx --bun-plugin @opentui/solid/bun-plugin --name gyst --outdir dist/release --resolver gyst --target bun-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-arm64 --target bun-darwin-x64 --target bun-darwin-arm64 --target bun-windows-x64 --target bun-windows-arm64
scripts.package: bun run package:host -- --target bun-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-arm64 --target bun-darwin-x64 --target bun-darwin-arm64 --target bun-windows-x64 --target bun-windows-arm64
scripts.package:host: cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE && cp ../../README.md README.md && crust build --package --entry src/index.tsx --bun-plugin @opentui/solid/bun-plugin --name gyst --stage-dir dist/npm
scripts.test: bun test && bun src/tui/smoke.tsx && bun src/tui/app-races.smoke.tsx
